violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program

violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION AND IS PROCESS OF GETTING MORE STAFF CERTIFIED/CERTIFICATIONS RENEWED. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at FRONT handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS TO THE DISPENSER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED BACK HANDWASHING SINK WITH FOOD DEBRIS IN THE SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER HANDWASHING SINK USAGE WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS STORED ON THE FLOOR OF THE WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS SHOULD BE ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE ENSURE THE ESTABLISHMENT DISCONTINUES USING THESE CONTAINERS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF APPROVED AND ARE NOT MEANT TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY. out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS STORED DIRECTLY IN GROCERY BAGS/TRASH BAGS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. PIC UNDERSTANDS FOOD SHOULD NOT BE STORED DIRECTLY IN GROCERY/TRASH BAGS AS THEY ARE NOT FOOD SAFE. PLEASE DISCONTINUE THIS PRACTICE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE SIGNED COPIES OF EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC COPIES AGAIN. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF SIGN COPIES AND SIGNED COPIES ARE KEPT ONSITE.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF BODILY FLUID CLEANUP PROCEDURE TO KEEP ONSITE.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEES WASH HANDS DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. PIC DISCUSSED PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED ON PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. PAPER TOWELS WERE NOT PROVIDED AT BACK HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE PAPER TOWELS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED AT ALL HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED FRONT HANDWASHING SINK WITHOUT SOAP.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC ADDED SOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE PAPER TOWELS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED AT ALL HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the BACK KITCHEN HANDWASHING SINK WITH BEAN SPROUTS IN A CONTAINER IN THE SINK BASIN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC REMOVED THE CONTAINER OF BEAN SPROUTS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ABOVE SOUPS IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED EGGS DURING INSPECTION AND PROPER RAW ORGANIZATION WAS DISCUSSED WITH THE PIC.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment was observed soiled to sight and touch: OBSERVED MEAT SLICER IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PLEASE ENSURE MEAT SLICER IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED BEEF BROTH IN THE WALK-IN COOLER AT 48F (MADE THE NIGHT PRIOR TO INSPECTION).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF BROTH DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COOLING FOODS MUST COOL FROM 135F TO 70F WITHIN 2 HOURS, AND 70F TO 41F OR BELOW IN NO MORE THAN AN ADDITIONAL 4 HOURS. PLEASE ENSURE COOLING METHODS ARE REVIEWED WITH STAFF.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED LARGE POT OF BEEF BROTH ON STOVE BURNER AT 112F; PIC CONFIRMED BROTH WAS ON STOVE BURNER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED OF BROTH DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS HOT HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE. PLEASE ENSURE FOOD ITEMS ARE NOT KEPT ON STOVE OVERNIGHT.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CONTAINERS OF HALF AND HALF IN FRONT 3-DOOR GLASS-FRONT COOLER AT 46F-48F AND COFFEE WITH MILK AT 47F. OBSERVED GARLIC IN OIL AT 68F ON COUNTER-TOP. OBSERVED BAGS OF BEAN SPROUTS AT 42-48F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE THE THREE-DOOR COOLER IS NOT USED UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34- 38F.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poisonous or Toxic Material
violations.observation: A container previously used to store SPLASH DETERGENT materials is being used to store FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: Do not store food in containers previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials. This practice may result in food contamination and subsequent medical consequences to anyone consuming the contaminated food. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS TEHSE CONTAINERS MAY NOT BE REUSED FOR FOOD STORAGE.

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. OBSERVED A BOTTLE OF MEDICINE STORED WITH FOOD ITEMS IN THE BACK HALLWAY.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC MOVED MEDICINE DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS EMPLOYEE BELONGINGS AND MEDICINE SHOULD BE SEGREGATED FROM FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED FROZEN RAW BEEF THAWING IN A PREP SINK (NOT UNDER CONTINUOUS RUNNING WATER).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PROPER THAWING METHODS WERE DISCUSSED WITH THE PIC. PIC MOVED BEEF DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS BOTTLES/CONTAINERS OF SAUCES/FOODS WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS NOT IN ORIGINAL CONTAINER ARE LABELED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS STORED ON THE FLOOR THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN AND IN WALK-IN COOLER/FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER WIPING CLOTH STORAGE WITH PIC.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED MULTIPLE KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP TOP UNITS/TABLES; OBSERVED CUPS STORED IN VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS WITHOUT HANDLES.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: PEANUT AND GARLIC PEEL manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE CONTAINERS MAY NOT USED AS THEY ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED AND ARE NOT MEANT TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY. PLEASE GRADUALLY DISCONTINUE USE.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that BOXES OF VARIOUS SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS were stored DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN BACK HALLWAY.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. PLEASE ENSURE ALL SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS ARE ELEVATED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED A TRASH BAG USED TO STORE DRY NOODLES AT THE COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC REMOVED NOODLES FROM TRASH BAG DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS TRASH BAGS CANNOT BE USED TO STORE FOOD ITEMS. Pho Duong Restaurant (Inspection Date: 12/30/2025) Page 2 of 5

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED CARDBOARD LINING SHELVES THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC UNDERSTANDS CARDBOARD SHOULD NOT BE USED AS IT IS NOT NONABSORBENT AND NOT DURABLE. PLEASE REMOVE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED TAKEOUT BAGS (GROCERY BAGS) USED TO DIRECTLY STORE VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. PIC UNDERSTANDS GROCERY BAGS ARE NOT FOOD SAFE AND CANNOT BE USED TO DIRECTLY STORE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THREE-DOOR GLASS-FRONT COOLER AT 42-48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OF HALF AND HALF AND COFFEE WITH MILK IN THE COOLER. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. Pho Duong Restaurant (Inspection Date: 12/30/2025) Page 4 of 5

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: INTERIOR OF ALL REFRIGERATORS, SHELVING UNITS, COOK-LINE EQUIPMENT, AND PLUMBING (AND SURROUNDING AREAS/FIXTURES).
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE ENSURE THESE AREAS ARE THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the BACK KITCHEN HANDWASHING SINK is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE ENSURE THE HANDWASHING SINK IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED MISSING CEILING TILES THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN; OBSERVED BROKEN TILING AT THE BASEBOARD NEAR DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA AND A HOLE IN THE WALL NEAR COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE ENSURE THE CEILING/WALLS/FLOORS ARE REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS AND WALLS THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN ARE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE ENSURE ENTIRETY OF THE BACK KITCHEN IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. PIC UNDERSTANDS MOPS SHOULD BE STORED UPRIGHT TO PROPERLY AIR-DRY.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program

violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' DID NOT OBSERVE SIGNED EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY IN PLACE.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY. PLEASE ENUSRE ALL STAFF SIGN A COPY AND SIGNED COPIES ARE KEPT ONSITE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PAPER TOWELS WERE ADDED TO SINKS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW EGGS OVER READY TO EAT SAUCES AND PRODUCE IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW FOOD SHALL NOT BE STORED OVER READY TO EAT FOOD AND REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING SYSTEM IN PLACE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED DATE MARKING REQUIREMENTS WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY THE TIME OF FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item: BEAN SPROUTS WITHOUT A FOUR HOUR TIME MARKING AS WELL.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS DRAFTED WRITTEN PROCEDURES WITH PIC AND DISCUSSED TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL REQUIREMENTS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS THROUGHOUT KITCHEN. OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES BY HOT WATER HEATER.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC UNDERSTANDS PEST CONTROL MUST SERVICE THE RESTAURANT PRIOR TO FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. PEST CONTROL SHALL SERVICE THE ESTABLISHMENT REGULARLY UNTIL ISSUE IS ELIMINATED.

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER STORAGE METHODS WITH PIC. PIC UNDERSTANDS FOOD SHALL BE STORED AT LEAST 6 INCHES ABOVE THE FLOOR.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: EXTERIOR/INTERIOR OF REFRIGERATION UNITS (INCLUDING HANDLES), SHELVING INSIDE WALK-IN COOLER, AND EQUIPMENT AT COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC UNDERSTANDS CORRECTIONS SHALL BE MADE BY THE TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW QUAIL AND RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE CUT JALAPEÑOS AND SHREDDED CABBAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS RAW FOODS SHOULD NOT BE STORED ABOVE ANY READY-TO-EAT FOODS.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED NUMEROUS CONTAINERS OF BEEF BROTH IN WALK-IN COOLER AT 46-49F, PREPARED THE NIGHT PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF BROTHS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS COOLING FOODS MUST MEET 41F OR BELOW WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item was observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED BEEF BROTH ON STOVE-TOP AT 110F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED BROTH TO 165F DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS HOT HOLDING FOODS MUST STAY AT 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SLICED STEAK AT 50F, SLICED STEAK 52F, SLICED CHICKEN AT 48F IN 2-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOODS TO OTHER COLD HOLDING UNIT AND UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR PREP TOP AT 46F, 51F WITH EHS THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC WILL ENSURE UNIT IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND UNDERSTANDS THAT UNITS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 34-38F.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. THREE-VAT SINK IS NOT AIR-GAPPED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PIC WILL ENSURE THAT THE THREE-VAT SINK IS REPAIRED, SO THAT THE SANITIZE BASIN IS AIR-GAPPED, WITHIN THREE DAYS.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that the end caps are missing from the protective light covering of fluorescent light fixtures THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PIC WILL ENSURE LIGHTS ARE SHIELDED.
